text:
The review-page proposal is clear, so I made no rewrite and logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

- **Text check:** `node Server/text-check.mjs` raised one flag. `past-work.md` runs to 840 words against a limit of 500.
- **Why I didn't rewrite it:** a script generates that file as agent input and marks it do-not-hand-edit. It is not something the owner reads.
- **The proposal itself:** `requirements.md` is also written for agents. It has a plain title, a numbered list of asks, and the owner's words linked.
- **Screenshots:** the proposal has no page, so I took none.
